text: dsh-pathfinder 是一个面向 DSH Web 的 agent-pathfinder 记录浏览插件。它通过宿主侧服务读取当前会话工作区中的 Pathfinder 数据，并在浏览器侧注册 Pathfinder Center 侧栏面板和设置页。面板提供路径关系图、节点详情、项目说明、指令管理和问题池视图；用户可以查看或维护指令，并调整归档指令和已关闭问题的显示方式。适合在 DSH 中跟踪 agent-pathfinder 项目进展、关系和待处理问题的用户。需要 DSH 0.2.x 兼容版本、带有 .pf/ 记录的工作区，以及 PATH 中可用的 pf 命令；无需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-pathfinder shows agent-pathfinder records in a DSH Web sidebar: a project map, node details, instructions, and issue pool. Users can manage instructions and display preferences. Requires DSH 0.2.x, a .pf/ workspace, and pf on PATH; no API key.

我想切换工作区，查看不同会话对应的项目记录。
I want to browse an agent-pathfinder project map and issue pool inside the DSH web interface.
How can I manage project instructions from the workspace associated with my current DSH session?
dsh-pathfinder 的功能「浏览项目记录」：在 Pathfinder Center 中查看项目地图、节点详情、指令和问题池。打开 DSH Web 侧栏面板后读取当前会话工作区的记录。
dsh-pathfinder 的功能「管理项目指令」：可将文字指令添加到全局、cycle 或 node 范围，也可归档、恢复或删除指令。在面板的指令视图中操作，并写回项目记录。
dsh-pathfinder 的功能「调整面板显示」：可设置默认标签页、侧栏宽度，以及是否显示归档指令和其他状态的问题。通过 Pathfinder Settings 页面修改插件偏好。

dsh-pathfinder README · dsh-pathfinder：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

`dsh-pathfinder` is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin
that renders an [agent-pathfinder](https://github.com/infraredsqy/agent-pathfinder) record as a
panel in the DSH Web UI.

dsh-pathfinder README · dsh-pathfinder：The host half reads the record (`.pf/`) of the current session's workspace and serves it behind a
gateway; the browser half draws it as the **Pathfinder Center** panel in the sidebar. Everything on screen —
instructions, node details, the map of who owes whom, the issue pool — comes from that record, and
writes from the panel go back to the same place.

dsh-pathfinder README · Status：Early, and tied to the DSH developer preview. The manifest declares an `engines.dsh` range, and DSH
refuses to install or boot the plugin outside that range (`incompatible-version`, with an opt-in
exemption command). The range follows DSH's breaking line: any rc within 0.2.x is admitted, and it
moves when DSH moves to 0.3.

The record it draws comes from [agent-pathfinder](https://github.com/infraredsqy/agent-pathfinder),
which is early and moving fast too: expect breaking changes on that side.

dsh-pathfinder README · Install：Prerequisites: a DSH install with a profile to install into, and a workspace that holds an
agent-pathfinder record (`.pf/`, with `pf` on your `PATH`). The panel reads the workspace of the
session you have selected; with no session selected it says so.

Download the `.tgz` from this repo's [Releases](https://github.com/infraredsqy/dsh-pathfinder/releases)
and point DSH at the file:

dsh-pathfinder README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./dsh-pathfinder-<version>.tgz
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-pathfinder                  # the same artifact, by name (npm)
```

The package ships prebuilt — installing runs no build steps. pnpm may print a few `missing peer`
warnings: those packages are provided by DSH itself and resolve at runtime, so the warnings can be
ignored. The version policy and the third route (installing from git) live in
[docs/publish.md](docs/publish.md).

dsh-pathfinder README · What you get：- a **Pathfinder Center** entry in the Web UI sidebar: views over the record — the map, details,
  instructions, the issue pool, and the panel's own settings
- a **Pathfinder Settings** section in the DSH settings: whether archived instructions show,
  whether closed issues show
- to verify an install: `dsh --profile <name> --dump-config`, and look for the
  `# == dsh-pathfinder` section

dsh-pathfinder README · Development：```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
npm test                  # unit tests; builds lib/client.js first, then mounts it in jsdom
node tools/css-check.mjs  # the style-layer rules
npm pack                  # the distributable

dsh-pathfinder README · Development：`npm test` covers the model layer, the host half and the built browser half — the last one mounts
`lib/client.js` over an in-memory record, walks every pane, and fails on any `console.error`. What it
cannot reach (the readings over a real `.pf`, the copy, the layout) is on the hand pass in
[docs/publish.md](docs/publish.md); `tools/testbed/` boots an isolated DSH instance to walk it.
